title: Source diversity
content: Source diversity describes how many different domains and kinds of content a single AI answer draws its citations from.

meta.why: An answer that draws on reviews, forums, vendor sites, and news gives a brand several kinds of pages on which to be found.
meta.example: One answer about project management tools cites a vendor's documentation, a review site, a community forum thread, and a trade publication.
meta.check: For each tracked prompt, sort the cited URLs by domain and by type, then note which types appear in answers where your own site is absent.
meta.limitation: Each engine chooses its sources by its own methods, and the mix changes between runs.
meta.sources: Animalz: AEO glossary | https://animalz.co/blog/aeo-glossary | Industry glossary
